title: 互联网巨头二季度最暗：AI商业化路径渐明，长期资金何时转向？
speaker: Edong (guest)

segments.en: Yeah, I mean, Kate, tell us what was going on with China Tech, because the earnings season hasn't really fared too well. I mean, investors have definitely punished some of these big tech names for the amount of AI CapEx that they're willing to spend for this build out. I'm just wondering your thoughts on the earnings season so far on what's going to be the next catalyst, really?
segments.zh: 中国科技板块业绩期表现不佳，市场对大型科技公司的AI资本开支有所担忧。您对业绩期和后续催化剂有何看法？

segments.en: Well, I think actually I think the second quarter is the darkest period for those internet giants in mainland China. So, at present, if you see in terms of the fundamental side, especially for those core businesses for these kind of internet giants, they're slightly higher than the market consensus in terms of the midterm results.
segments.zh: 我认为二季度是内地互联网巨头最困难的时期。目前核心业务基本面略好于市场预期。

segments.en: And also actually I think the market focus shift to AI CapEx currently, but for the AI CapEx or how to interpret the AI CapEx at present. I think that if you see the first half of this year for many large internet giants, it is very hard for them to find clear paths to commercialization for those AI products.
segments.zh: 市场焦点转向AI资本开支，但上半年许多大型互联网公司难以找到清晰的AI商业化路径。

segments.en: But now you can see that especially for those AI agents, especially the official AI agent become an important tool for those internet giants at present. So, we think that in terms of the fundamental side and also in terms of the valuation side, it's very hard for those internet giants to come back to those low level in the first half of this year.
segments.zh: 但现在AI代理成为重要工具，从基本面和估值看，很难回到上半年的低点。

segments.en: But I think that it's still need time for the investors. It's especially those long-term investors to see the potential catalysts in the future, where I think that the potential catalysts may come from the commercialization path for the AI services like cloud services and also some AI agent in the future.
segments.zh: 但投资者仍需时间，长期投资者关注未来催化剂，可能来自云服务和AI代理的商业化。
